description: This source file (UpgradeWizard_commit.php) handles the upgrade process for SuiteCRM, including module installation, patch application, language pack management, and related post-installation/uninstallation procedures. It orchestrates the upgrading, disabling, enabling, and rollback of modules and patches, and manages related configurations and upgrade history records.

classes.name: UpgradeHistory
classes.description: Represents the record of a module or patch upgrade, handling storage, retrieval, and deletion of upgrade entries, including MD5 checksum matching.

methods.name: UWrebuild
methods.description: Function to rebuild system relationships and modules after an upgrade.

calls: content of include files (post_install, post_uninstall, pre_install, pre_uninstall)
